rules.status-not-available: A candidate must be available at the snapshot.
rules.capability-missing: A candidate must have the required capability.
rules.qualification-not-retrieved: No qualification record was retrieved for this candidate; do not infer source absence.
rules.qualification-not-applicable: Among retrieved records, at least one must match product AND capability AND inclusive validity dates at the snapshot.

limits: Advisory on selected evidence only; does not authorize equipment use or certify physical safety. A conforming false fact can pass. A wrong interpretation can pass.
